Marta: Following up on the billing postmortem — I pulled together the remediation action items. Please ack ownership and post an ETA (days/hours).

Devin: Ack. I'll own tokens parity investigation (compare reported token counts vs runtime counters). ETA: EOD Wed.

Sanjay: I can take the delayed-ingestion fix and backfill plan. Need exact time range for missing events.

Marta: @Alex can you own invoice corrections/credits? Need to coordinate with billing ops and CS.

Alex: Yep, I'll own invoice remediation. Will open a billing ops ticket and collect affected customers. ETA: initial list by tomorrow noon.

billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-2026-457 (billing ops) - https://tracker.internal/bill/BILL-2026-457

Devin: Query I'm using to validate token counts (compare exporter vs usage pipeline):
```sql
SELECT day, sum(exporter_tokens) AS exporter, sum(pipeline_tokens) AS pipeline,
  1.0 * sum(pipeline_tokens)/NULLIF(sum(exporter_tokens),0) AS ratio
FROM metering.daily_token_totals
WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

Sanjay: From logs the Kafka consumer shows lag spike during 2026-02-12 03:12-03:42 UTC. Plan: run dedupe/backfill job against raw events + replay windowed aggregates. I'll sketch runbook and test in staging. ETA: Thu EOD.

Marta: Also want to track recurring patterns — add a recurring telemetry check for ingestion lag >5% over a 30m window. @ops-sre can you add that alert and a runbook pointer?

ops-sre: added alert rule: "metering.ingest_lag_pct" threshold 5% (30m), PagerDuty integration set to sev2. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/metering-ingest-lag.

Alex: For invoice corrections: I'll prepare a template for customer emails and coordinate with Legal & CS. Once we have the affected-customer list, I'll queue credits and create follow-up tasks.

Marta: I added an action tracker sheet (viewable to finance + eng): https://sheets.internal/redwood/metering-postmortem-actions. Please add your owner rows.

Sanjay: One blocker for the backfill: need a DB replica snapshot from before 2026-02-12 03:00 UTC to ensure idempotent backfill. @Devin can you create snapshot and share access?

Devin: On it. Creating snapshot now and will share S3 path.

billing-bot: Invoice corrections processed (queued) for 12 customers; credits pending approval in BILL-2026-457.

Alex: I pushed the initial list of affected customers to the ticket and flagged high-touch accounts for CS.

Marta: Thanks — let's reconvene at the weekly postmortem follow-up on Mon 09:30 to close outstanding items. If anything slips, update the tracker and ping @marta. :white_check_mark:
